principle: Display human translation evidence and its scope; AI translation, human review and extraction method are separate facts.

evidence.finding: The association identifies HadeethEnc as one of its platforms.
The publisher describes translators, language proofreading, religious review and approval. Named translators and AI use for these exact exported passages are not stated.
The association-associated platform describes AI assistance with human review. Its existence neither proves nor excludes AI use in any particular bank record.

evidence.date_scope: signed afterword; not an inferred publication date

classification_rules.publisher_human_workflow: Human source classification follows the owner instruction and publisher-described translator workflow; exact-record ai_translation stays as supplied.
classification_rules.human_translator_credited: Named translator and historical source evidence support human origin.
classification_rules.unknown: No established author/process attribution for the exact source; retain unknown.

source_record_policy: Canonical records and their historic assertions are unchanged. These evidence-backed labels are a separately versioned display/search layer.
